cycle_26_slots.summary: assoc::normalise_address (household-grouping key for AU-049 shared-residence + AU-051 shared-surname kin) DELETED '# . - / \\'. Deleting the unit/range separators '/' and '-' collapsed distinct dwellings: '1/2 Oak St' (unit 1 of #2) and '12 Oak St' (#12) both -> '12 oak st', fusing two unrelated people into one false household (AU-049 High) and, on a shared surname, a false kin finding (AU-051). Fix: fold '# - / \\' to a single space (so '1 2 oak st' != '12 oak st', and 'Main-St' == 'Main St'), but KEEP dropping '.' so intra-token abbreviations still collapse (N.S.W -> nsw == NSW; folding '.' would split them — a refinement over the raw audit suggestion, verified against is_specific_residence which counts comma/whitespace tokens). Unit form stays a valid specific residence, so genuine co-residents at the same unit still group. Updated blessing test (renamed normalise_address_folds_separators_and_trims: Main-St. -> 'main st'); added regressions normalise_address_keeps_unit_and_range_separators_distinct + end-to-end au049_unit_address_and_street_number_are_not_one_household. No existing AU-049/051 test fed an affected char (all use '123 Main St, Springfield' style). scripts/gate.sh --quick GREEN, fmt run pre-gate.
